## Functional summary

The sequence is an **exact match** to reviewed UniProt protein **Q7T0Z0**, annotated as **mitochondrial methionine–tRNA ligase** (methionyl-tRNA synthetase; **EC 6.1.1.10**). This ATP-dependent enzyme charges mitochondrial tRNA\(^\text{Met}\) with L-methionine, producing methionyl-tRNA for mitochondrial protein synthesis.

**Overall reaction:**

\[
\text{tRNA}^{\text{Met}} + \text{L-methionine} + \text{ATP}
\rightarrow
\text{L-methionyl-tRNA}^{\text{Met}} + \text{AMP} + \text{diphosphate (PP}_{i}\text{)}
\]

The assignment is strongly supported by the exact sequence match, curated reference annotation, and tRNA-synthetase/anticodon-binding domain matches. The reference protein is localized to the **mitochondrial matrix**. **ATP** is a required substrate; the retrieved evidence does not establish an additional specific cofactor.
